title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.7.3
body_markdown:
*released Aug 29th, 2023*

### Summary of What's New in this Release of Visual Studio 2022 version 17.7.3

* Added support to list simulators and devices with Xcode 15 and removed the NewsstandKit hard link dependency.
* Fixed an issue preventing the Visual Studio Installer from running when there is a symlink in the installer path.
* The new Include Cleanup feature for C++ which was added in 17.7 has been causing crashes for users, so we have disabled it for now, with a view to re-enable in 17.8

### Developer Community

* [Opening a solution hangs if any files from a certain project were open](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Opening-a-solution-hangs-if-any-files-fr/10434564)
* [VS 2022 crashes when attempting to open .sql file](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/VS-2022-crashes-when-attempting-to-open-/10442807)
* [Kestrel Url containing wildcards not working on Visual Studio 2022 17.7](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Kestrel-Url-containing-wildcards-not-wor/10438852)
* [VSIX installation failure on VS2022](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/VSIX-installation-failure-on-VS2022/10441279)
* [With New VS 2022 Update 17.7.0 Functional test are not working](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/With-New-VS-2022-Update-1770-Functiona/10437810)
